policy.scope: Generic md-comp-button bridge drift between Material Web generic Button tokens and effective Compose baseline Button defaults.
policy.rule: The generic Web module is semantically remapped onto baseline layout, small expressive shape/motion, and Filled variant state tokens. Only genuine value disagreements are exceptions.

drift.reason: Pinned Compose ButtonDefaults explicitly keeps IconSize at 18.dp with a TODO to update when the correct BaselineButtonTokens value becomes available; the generic Material Web token is already 20px.

semanticRemaps.reason: Generic Material Web Button combines legacy baseline geometry, expressive small shape/motion, and Filled toggle state roles. The canonical corpus keeps those concerns in baseline, size.small, and variant.filled rather than duplicating a fourth hierarchy.
